column1: # Dual-app layout so the controller can flash itself over the air. huge_app.csv
# has a single 3 MB slot and no space for a second image; two 1.5 MB slots still
# leave ~20% headroom over the current ~1.26 MB build.
# NVS keeps its original offset and size so switching from huge_app.csv over
# USB leaves Wi-Fi credentials and the pairing intact.
